record.paper_title: Some Open Problems on Multiple Ergodic Averages
record.original_question: For integer sequences a1(n), ..., aℓ(n), prove that the following are equivalent: (i) for every probability-measure-preserving system with commuting transformations T1, ..., Tℓ and every bounded measurable f1, ..., fℓ, the averages (1/N) Σ_{n=1}^N T1^{a1(n)} f1 · ... · Tℓ^{aℓ(n)} fℓ converge in L^2; (ii) the same convergence holds for all ℓ-step nilsystems; and (iii) for every basic generalized ℓ-step nilsequence ψ in ℓ variables, the scalar averages (1/N) Σ_{n=1}^N ψ(a1(n), ..., aℓ(n)) converge.

evidence.quote: Problem 3. If (a1(n)), . . . ,(a`(n)) are sequences of integers, then show that the following statements are equivalent: • The sequences (a1(n)), . . . ,(a`(n)) are good for `-convergence of commuting transformations. • The sequences (a1(n)), . . . ,(a`(n)) are good for `-convergence of `-step nilsystems. • The sequence (1/N)PN n=1 ψ(a1(n), . . . , a`(n)) converges for every basic generalized `-step nilsequence ψ in `-variables.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let ℓ ≥ 1 be an integer and let a_1(n), …, a_ℓ(n) be sequences of integers. A measure-preserving system is a quadruple (X, 𝒳, μ, T_1, …, T_ℓ) where (X, 𝒳, μ) is a probability space and T_1, …, T_ℓ : X → X are commuting invertible measure-preserving transformations. An ℓ-step nilsystem is a system of the form (G/Γ, m, R_{b_1}, …, R_{b_ℓ}) where G is an ℓ-step nilpotent Lie group, Γ ⊂ G is a discrete cocompact subgroup, m is the Haar measure on G/Γ, and each R_{b_i} acts by left translation by an element b_i ∈ G. A basic ℓ-step nilsequence in ℓ variables is a sequence of the form (n_1, …, n_ℓ) ↦ F(b_1^{n_1} ⋯ b_ℓ^{n_ℓ} · Γ) for some ℓ-step nilmanifold G/Γ, some commuting b_1, …, b_ℓ ∈ G, and some continuous function F : G/Γ → ℂ. A generalized basic ℓ-step nilsequence is a uniform limit of basic ℓ-step nilsequences.

Prove that the following three statements are equivalent:

(i) For every probability measure-preserving system (X, 𝒳, μ, T_1, …, T_ℓ) with commuting transformations and for all bounded measurable functions f_1, …, f_ℓ : X → ℂ, the averages
   (1/N) ∑_{n=1}^N (T_1^{a_1(n)} f_1) · (T_2^{a_2(n)} f_2) ⋯ (T_ℓ^{a_ℓ(n)} f_ℓ)
converge in L^2(μ) as N → ∞.

(ii) The convergence in (i) holds whenever (X, 𝒳, μ, T_1, …, T_ℓ) is an ℓ-step nilsystem and f_1, …, f_ℓ are continuous functions on it.

(iii) For every basic generalized ℓ-step nilsequence ψ in ℓ variables, the scalar averages
   (1/N) ∑_{n=1}^N ψ(a_1(n), …, a_ℓ(n))
converge as N → ∞.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in a well-known list of open problems on multiple ergodic averages. While partial progress has been made for specific classes (polynomial iterates, Hardy field functions, and certain weighted averages), no search result indicates a full proof of the equivalence of these three convergence criteria for arbitrary integer sequences. The problem appears to remain open in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems on multiple ergodic averages
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems including the criterion for ℓ-fold convergence of commuting transformations via nilsystems and nilsequences.
status_evidence.claim: Problem stated as open in the survey of multiple ergodic averages.

status_evidence.title: Multiple ergodic averages along functions from a Hardy field
status_evidence.snippet: Confirms some of the conjectures posed by Frantzikinakis for Hardy field iterates.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial progress for restricted classes; general equivalence not established.

status_evidence.title: Nilsequences and multiple correlations along subsequences
status_evidence.snippet: Studies links between nilsequence averages and convergence of multiple ergodic averages.
status_evidence.claim: Active area with ongoing partial results, full criterion not yet proved.
